principle: Source evidence -> upstream semantic reasoning -> closed AST/ADT capability contract -> wiring/projection -> runtime execution; runtime must not infer business meaning.

checks.name: CLI scan enters the canonical manifest producer interface
checks.detail: scan consumes manifestBuilder rather than constructing semantic routes locally

checks.name: CLI sync enters the same canonical manifest producer interface
checks.detail: sync shares the same upstream manifest construction boundary

checks.name: source-AST executor publishes complete/blocked projection ADT before manifest construction
checks.detail: completeness is judged by the source-AST executor and the manifest builder consumes its complete arm

checks.name: upstream builder creates complete Laravel source model
checks.detail: source model is built from a validated complete AST

checks.name: semantic dataflow is derived upstream of manifest consumers
checks.detail: dataflow input and judgments are materialized before manifest publication

checks.name: manifest retains AST, source model, dataflow, and group capability surfaces
checks.detail: manifest exposes distinct semantic products instead of collapsing them to route-only data

checks.name: operation identity is a closed upstream capability contract
checks.detail: identity materialization preserves reasoning, derivation, and provenance

checks.name: operation identity projection consumes upstream capability
checks.detail: projection reads resolved identity rather than reclassifying method/path

checks.name: resource-group shape is computed by upstream algebra
checks.detail: group-shape reasoning occurs before CLI projection

checks.name: React receives an explicit CRUD slot contract on generated config
checks.detail: generated contract carries direct endpoint slots into React wiring

checks.name: React contract path does not need role inference
checks.detail: contract-present branch directly consumes endpoint references

checks.name: existing semantic ownership and data-loss audits remain available
checks.detail: prior audits are retained and not replaced by a shallow aggregate check

residuals.detail: The closed resource-group contract carries only group shape/evidence, not the executable CRUD slot assignment needed by generators.
residuals.nextMove: Represent slot selection as a closed ADT of route references plus explicit absence; preserve provenance and ambiguity diagnostics.

residuals.detail: Legacy descriptor APIs still expose role-based route selection/classification helpers.
residuals.nextMove: Trace callers and move remaining selection to upstream resource-group capability algebra before retiring compatibility APIs.

externalDesignReferences.relevance: Consumers should operate through semantic interfaces rather than hard-code per-operation special cases.
AST nodes and dataflow nodes are related but distinct models; preserve both rather than flattening them.
Query keys must uniquely identify returned data and include variables affecting the query.
Compiler/toolchain version must be verified separately from architecture audits.
